item.title: Mushroom Men (Seeking Greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Sentient mushrooms which: duplicate on death, are friendly, incredibly poisonous, are a hive-mind, and connected via a long chain of memory-storing mycelium.

Central Narrative: Most story will come from interviews with the mushrooms, such as what they have seen, how long have they existed, etc

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Their ability to replicate upon death and store and share knowledge. Their general lovability and unawareness, and there not really being many mushroom based SCPs on the wiki.

Additional Notes: I think I am probably struggling with the elevator pitch, central narrative and hook, so if you have any suggestions, please do share.
